title: chore: pin polli 0.1.44 in the sandbox image
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Pinned polli in the E2B sandbox Dockerfile from 0.1.42 to 0.1.44, bringing in per-model key IDs and the herdr bootstrap. A test image build reported polli 0.1.44; the other pins, including herdr 0.9.3, were unchanged.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art workshop, Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. Wearing a tiny tool belt, she checks a sandbox image box labeled '0.1.44' beside a glowing terminal and potted code-plants; lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently against a warm cream and soft pastel gradient background, with dark purple (#110518) outlines, chunky sprites, cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
